题目内容: 计算 n 阶行列式 $D_{n}=\left|\begin{matrix}b&a&a&\cdots&a\\ a&b&a&\cdots&a\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\ a&a&a&\cdots&b\end{matrix}\right|$ .
解析:
解法1 $D_{n}$ 的各列元素之和相等, 用行加法, 有

$\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} & = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} b + (n - 1) a & b + (n - 1) a & b + (n - 1) a & \dots & b + (n - 1) a \\ a & b & a & \dots & a \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ a & a & a & \dots & b \end{array} \right| \\ & = [ b + (n - 1) a ] \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ a & b & a & \dots & a \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ a & a & a & \dots & b \end{array} \right| \end{array}$

$= [ b + (n - 1) a ] \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 0 & b - a & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & b - a \end{array} \right| = [ b + (n - 1) a ] (b - a) ^ {n - 1}.$

解法2 $D_{n}$ 除主对角线上元素以外, 其余列元素均相同, 可用加边法, 有

$D _ {n} = D _ {n + 1} = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & a & a & \dots & a \\ 0 & b & a & \dots & a \\ 0 & a & b & \dots & a \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 0 & a & a & \dots & b \end{array} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & a & a & \dots & a \\ - 1 & b - a & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ - 1 & 0 & b - a & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ - 1 & 0 & 0 & \dots & b - a \end{array} \right|,$

这是箭形行列式,故

$D _ {n} = (b - a) ^ {n - 1} \cdot [ b + (n - 1) a ].$

【注】当 $\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2},\cdots,\lambda_{n}$ 均不为零时，箭形行列式

$D _ {n + 1} = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} \lambda_ {0} & a _ {1} & a _ {2} & \dots & a _ {n} \\ b _ {1} & \lambda_ {1} & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ b _ {2} & 0 & \lambda_ {2} & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ b _ {n} & 0 & 0 & \dots & \lambda_ {n} \end{array} \right| = \left(\lambda_ {0} - \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {b _ {i} a _ {i}}{\lambda_ {i}}\right) \lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2} \dots \lambda_ {n}.$

本结论见《2027考研数学线性代数辅导讲义》.

题目内容: 计算 n 阶行列式 $D_{n}=\left|\begin{array}{cccccc}2 & -1 & 0 & \cdots & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 & \cdots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 2 & \cdots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \cdots & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \cdots & -1 & 2\end{array}\right|$ .
解析:
解 $D_{n}$ 为三对角行列式,用递推法,将 $D_{n}$ 按第 1 行展开,得

$D _ {n} = 2 D _ {n - 1} + (- 1) \times (- 1) ^ {1 + 2} \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} - 1 & - 1 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & - 1 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 & 2 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 2 & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & - 1 & 2 \end{array} \right| = 2 D _ {n - 1} - D _ {n - 2},$

即

$\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} - D _ {n - 1} & = D _ {n - 1} - D _ {n - 2} = D _ {n - 2} - D _ {n - 3} = \dots = D _ {2} - D _ {1} \\ & = \left| \begin{array}{c c} 2 & - 1 \\ - 1 & 2 \end{array} \right| - 2 = 1, \end{array}$

故

$\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} & = D _ {n - 1} + 1 = (D _ {n - 2} + 1) + 1 = D _ {n - 2} + 2 = \dots = D _ {1} + (n - 1) \\ & = 2 + (n - 1) = n + 1. \end{array}$

题目内容: 设 A 是 3 阶可逆矩阵， $A^{-1}$ 的特征值为 3,2,1，则 $|A|$ 的代数余子式之和 $A_{11} + A_{22} + A_{33} = (\quad)$ .

D.

解 因为伴随矩阵 $A^{*}$ 的主对角线元素为 $A_{11}, A_{22}, A_{33}$ ，所以 $A_{11} + A_{22} + A_{33}$ 的值等于 $A^{*}$ 的 3 个特征值之和,故只需求 $A^{*}$ 的 3 个特征值.

由 $\mathbf{A}^{-1}$ 的特征值为3,2,1，可知 $\mathbf{A}$ 的特征值为 $\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{2},1$ ，则

$| \textbf {A} | = \lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2} \lambda_ {3} = \frac {1}{3} \times \frac {1}{2} \times 1 = \frac {1}{6},$

故 $\mathbf{A}^{*}$ 的3个特征值分别为 $\frac{|A|}{\lambda_1} = \frac{1}{2}, \frac{|A|}{\lambda_2} = \frac{1}{3}, \frac{|A|}{\lambda_3} = \frac{1}{6}$ , 所以

$A _ {1 1} + A _ {2 2} + A _ {3 3} = \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{3} + \frac {1}{6} = 1.$

【注】结论:设 $\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2},\cdots,\lambda_{n}$ 为矩阵 A 的特征值,则:

① $\left| A \right| = \lambda_{1} \lambda_{2} \cdots \lambda_{n};$

② $a_{11} + a_{22} + \cdots + a_{mn} = \lambda_{1} + \lambda_{2} + \cdots + \lambda_{n};$

③ $A^{-1}$ 的特征值为 $\frac{1}{\lambda_{1}}, \frac{1}{\lambda_{2}}, \cdots, \frac{1}{\lambda_{n}} (\lambda_{i} \neq 0; i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ ;

④ $A^{*}$ 的特征值为 $\frac{|A|}{\lambda_{1}}, \frac{|A|}{\lambda_{2}}, \cdots, \frac{|A|}{\lambda_{n}} (\lambda_{i} \neq 0; i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ .

题目内容: 设 A 是 3 阶方阵, 且满足 $\left|A-E\right|=\left|A+2E\right|=\left|2A+3E\right|=0$ , 则 $\left|2A^{*}-3E\right|=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
126.

解 先求出 A 的特征值, 再求 $2A^{*}-3E$ 的特征值.

由 $|\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{E}| = |(-1)(\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{A})| = (-1)^3 |\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{A}| = 0$ ，得 $|1\cdot \mathbf{E} - \mathbf{A}| = 0$ ，可知 $\lambda_1 = 1$ 是 $\mathbf{A}$ 的一个特征值.

同理，由 $|\mathbf{A} + 2\mathbf{E}| = |2\mathbf{A} + 3\mathbf{E}| = 0$ ，得 $\mathbf{A}$ 的特征值 $\lambda_{2} = -2,\lambda_{3} = -\frac{3}{2}$ 故

$|A|= \lambda_{1} \lambda_{2} \lambda_{3}=3 \neq 0$ (A 可逆),

所以 $A^{*}$ 的特征值分别为 $\frac{|A|}{\lambda_{1}} = \frac{3}{1} = 3$ , $\frac{|A|}{\lambda_{2}} = \frac{3}{-2} = -\frac{3}{2}$ , $\frac{|A|}{\lambda_{3}} = -2$ , 于是 $2A^{*} - 3E$ 的特征值分别为

$2 \times 3 - 3 = 3, 2 \times \left(- \frac {3}{2}\right) - 3 = - 6, 2 \times (- 2) - 3 = - 7,$

所以 $\left|2A^{*}-3E\right|=3\times(-6)\times(-7)=126.$

这是箭形行列式,故 $D_{n}=b^{n-1}\left(b-\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}^{2}\right)$ .
